name: Athame Artis
passiveDesc: CRIT DMG from Elemental Bursts is increased by 32%. When an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blade of the Daylight Hours effect: ATK is increased by 40%. Nearby active party members other than the equipping character have their ATK increased by 32% for 3s.Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, the effects of Blade of the Daylight Hours are increased by an additional 75%. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
